title: tragus racemosus
intro: Tragus racemosus, commonly known as "Mundige" or "Dhataki", is a plant species that belongs to the family Asclepiadaceae. It is an herb used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine, known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce stress, anxiety, and fever, as well as its use in treating various respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Tragus racemosus include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can aid in relieving coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
